provenance.elevation_disclaimer: Elevation is a modelling assumption inferred from BTP / BBMP grade separation documentation (+6.5m to +7.0m deck, 0.0m surface), never survey data.

coordinate_transform.scene_origin_description: 1 unit = 1 metre. Centered at network midpoint (350, 350). For Three.js (Y-up): scene_x = sumo_x - 350, scene_y = sumo_z, scene_z = -(sumo_y - 350).
